#summary This wiki explains how to install Windows development tools for GIMX.

= Introduction =

This wiki explains how to install a compilation environment (based on MinGW) and Eclipse CDT (with SVN).
It also explains how to perform a checkout and build the project.

Target OS is Windows, but it can be easily adapted to Linux.
Unless otherwise specified, perform a default installation (default directories, etc).

= Compiler & librairies =

=== MinGW ===

Download and run the latest <a href="http://sourceforge.net/projects/mingw/files/Automated%20MinGW%20Installer/mingw-get-inst">mingw-get-inst</a> version (as of this writing, 20110802).
The only thing to configure during the installation process: in the "Select Components panel, select "C++ Compiler" and "MSYS Basic System".
Add C:\MinGW\bin and C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\bin to your system PATH.

=== SDL ===

Run C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\msys.bat and install patch ($ mingw-get install msys-patch) and wget ($ mingw-get install wget).

Download and extract <a href="http://www.libsdl.org/release/SDL-1.2.14.tar.gz">SDL 1.2.4</a> to C:\SDL-1.2.14.

Run C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\msys.bat, change to the directory you installed the SDL source ($ cd /c/SDL-1.2.14/).

Download the SDL patch ($ wget http://diyps3controller.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/libsdl/patch.win), and patch the source ($ patch -p1 < patch.win).

Configure ($ ./configure --prefix=/c/MinGW), make ($ make) and install ($ make install).

=== wxWidgets ===

These instructions are taken from this wiki: <a href="http://wiki.wxwidgets.org/Compiling_wxWidgets_with_MSYS-MinGW">link</a>.

Download and install <a href="http://www.wxwidgets.org/downloads/#latest_stable">the latest stable wxMSW installer for windows</a>. As of this writing, the latest version is 2.8.12.

Run C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\msys.bat and change to the directory you installed the wx source ($ cd /c/wxWidgets-2.8.12/).

Create a new build directory ($ mkdir msw-gimx) and enter that directory ($ cd msw-gimx).

Configure ($ ../configure --disable-shared --enable-unicode --prefix=/c/MinGW), make ($ make) and install ($ make install).

=== libxml ===

Run C:\MinGW\msys\1.0\msys.bat, install mingw32-libiconv (mingw-get install mingw32-libiconv) and install msys-libxml2 ($ mingw-get  install msys-libxml2).

Copy libxml headers and binary to the MinGW directory ($ cp -a /c/MinGW/msys/1.0/include/libxml2/libxml/ /c/MinGW/include/) ($ cp /c/MinGW/msys/1.0/lib/libxml2.dll.a /c/MinGW/lib).

Edit C:\MinGW\include\libxml\xmlexports.h: replace line 116 with "  #if defined(IN_LIBXML) && !defined(LIBXML_STATIC)".

= Eclipse =

Be sure to have a <a href="http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/java/javase/downloads/index.html">java JRE</a> installed on your system.

Download <a href="http://www.eclipse.org/downloads/">Eclipse IDE for C/C++ Developers</a>. Unzip it to wherever you want.

Run eclipse.exe.

=== SVN Plugin ===

Help>Install New Software

Work with: select your eclipse release name (as of this writing, Indigo).

type filter text: svn

Select "Subversive SVN Integration for the Mylyn Project" and "Subversive SVN Team Provider".

Proceed to installation (select latest SVN Kit - 1.3.5 as of this writing), and restart eclipse.

=== Project checkout ===

Project Explorer view, right click, New>Other.

Select SVN>Project from SVN, click next.

Enter URL: https://diyps3controller.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/sixaxis-emu

Click next, Click no (do not nomalize URL), and click "Trust Always" (googlecode certificate).

Click Head Revision, and click Finish.

Check out as: Select "Check out as a project configured using the New Project Wizard", select "Head Revision", and click finish.

Select a wizard: Select "C project" and click next.

Enter a Project name, and select "Makefile Project > Empty Project", and click next.

Click Finish.

Check out is performed, and the new project appears in the Project Explorer view.

The project is build automatically.
